name: diff-explorer
description: Review a pull request's diff in a pane beside the chat and ask Claude about selected lines

baseRef.title: Default base ref
baseRef.description: What /explore . and /explore <branch> measure the diff from when no base ref is typed after the target. Empty tries origin/HEAD, then main, then master. A pull request is measured from its own base branch.

foldLines.title: Fold threshold
foldLines.description: Changed lines from which a file starts folded in the pane; 0 folds every file.

inlineRows.title: Inline pane rows
inlineRows.description: Body rows the pane asks for while it sits above the prompt, in a terminal under 110 columns. 0 leaves it to the layout, a third of the screen. The dock beside a wide transcript ignores it.
